city_center.name: Downtown Nashville (Broadway / Music Row) + Nashville Farmers' Market
city_center.landmark: Broadway honky-tonk strip and the Nashville Farmers' Market at Bicentennial Capitol Mall; Cumberland River through downtown
city_center.notes: Music City metro. Kroger (Cincinnati-based, dominant across TN) is the home grocer; Publix has expanded into Middle Tennessee. Nashville Farmers' Market peak growing season runs May to November. sources: nashvillefarmersmarket.org; Kroger TN footprint.

featured_frontier.signature_ingredient: Tennessee tomatoes (Jun-Oct) + hot-honey (Nashville hot-chicken heat tie) and summer sweet corn

cultural_notes: Nashville is Music City -- the Broadway honky-tonk strip and Music Row anchor a country-and-live-music identity, and Nashville hot chicken is the city's signature dish (source: general regional knowledge; nashvillesites.org South Broadway architecture; language selection flagged INFERRED)
Nashville is home to the largest Kurdish community in the US, centered in 'Little Kurdistan' in south Nashville (source: general regional demographic knowledge; language selection flagged INFERRED)

Tennessee tomatoes run June through October (sometimes into November in warm years), and the Nashville Farmers' Market's peak growing season is May to November (source: bcbstwelltuned.com Tennessee tomato guide; nashvillefarmersmarket.org)
